title: Phone Call: Media Inquiry on Voter Roll Deletions

transcript.speaker: Marissa Lin
transcript.text: This is Marissa Lin from The Carrow Courier. We’re getting 10,000 calls from people saying they were deleted from the voter rolls — is that true? One woman says she was told she’s not registered and was turned away at her polling place. We need a statement.

transcript.speaker: Gwen Hartley
transcript.text: I’m sorry, we’re not aware of any mass deletions. We’re actively investigating reports from Polling Location 6 and the Early Vote Center. All voters are welcome to vote in person. We’ll issue a public statement shortly.

transcript.speaker: Marissa Lin
transcript.text: Okay, but people are panicking. A woman in Precinct 111 says she’s been on the list for 20 years and now she’s not. Is she allowed to vote?

transcript.speaker: Gwen Hartley
transcript.text: Yes. She should vote a provisional ballot. We’re verifying the system now.

transcript.speaker: Marissa Lin
transcript.text: And the location change — Carrow Middle School — that’s not right, is it? The church is still open.

transcript.speaker: Gwen Hartley
transcript.text: That information is inaccurate. The official site for Polling Location 6 remains Carrow Community Church. We’re addressing the error.

transcript.speaker: Marissa Lin
transcript.text: We’re running this live on Channel 9 in 15 minutes. Can you confirm you’ll have a statement out by 10:00?

transcript.speaker: Gwen Hartley
transcript.text: We’re working on it. I’ll have someone from Communications contact you within the hour.

transcript.speaker: Marissa Lin
transcript.text: Good. We need to stop the panic. Thanks for answering.

transcript.speaker: Gwen Hartley
transcript.text: Thank you for calling.
